Overview

Šiauliai is a city in Šiauliai County with a population of 100,000. Lithuania’s fourth-largest city, known for the Hill of Crosses nearby, a vibrant university life, and a growing manufacturing and logistics sector. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
